items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5
items.summary: Anthropic positions Claude Opus 5 as close to Claude Fable 5's capability at half the price, keeping Opus 4.8's $5/$25 per million token pricing. It reports leading results on several coding and agent benchmarks, and the model is the default on Claude Max.
